criteria.requirement: Add shop.py reconcile CATALOG COUNTS_JSON --output NEW_JSON for a real physical-count reconciliation. Each existing sku appears at most once with strict nonnegative integer absolute quantity; reject duplicate/unknown/negative/bool/malformed records for whole batch. Uncounted items remain unchanged, counted zero is real zero, same value creates no difference. Preserve catalog order/names/input bytes, atomically publish complete new canonical catalog using delivered exclusive output policy. Print counted/changed and exact sku/before/after/delta differences only after success. This differs from delta adjustment/order fulfillment by explicit absolute-count semantics.

Investigate the real source, explain the call path and clarify the business requirements before obtaining plan approval and implementing. Deliver real engineering changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. Repair independently reported failures; questions, answers and documentation do not count as separate completed objectives.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual business behavior and the frozen scope; do not grade by matching the reference patch text.
